text: おれ　なんか　もう　４０しゅるい　つかまえたぜ！

structure.jp: もう　４０しゅるい　つかまえたぜ！

patterns.name: 〜なんか
patterns.explanation: なんか after a word holds it up as an example, here to brag: 'take me, for instance'. おれ なんか = 'me, for one'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky boys' talk that pushes the statement at the listener. つかまえたぜ = 'I caught them, you know!'
